what.text: This page follows refugees from Kenya living in Canada, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4287 Kenyan refugees in Canada, 32.2% of all refugees from Kenya.
Ethiopia hosts the most Kenyan refugees, followed by Canada, the United States and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Northeastern Province and Coast territory in Kenya with Al-Shabaab in every year from 2015 to 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2024 and 2025, fall within that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1994 at 492 refugees.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Canada.
These are year-end totals for Canada only, reported to UNHCR.
